content: Merikɨtsɨ tawarita tukita kaneutahani, tewi mɨmamawakikai muwa kanayekateitɨni.
Hipatɨ mɨkɨ mekanihupiekaitɨni 'aixɨa 'aneme kapayeitɨani 'uxipiya tukaritsie meteyɨkɨhɨawetɨ, me'ixanetakutɨ.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe tewi mɨmamawakikai: —Kenanukukexi, hixɨapa keneutakexi.

Mɨpaɨ Ketsutsi katiniwaruta'iwawiya: —¿'Uxipiya tukaritsie tiheitserie 'aixɨa mɨtiyurieneni, nutsutɨ 'axamɨtiyurieneni, tiheitserie mɨtiyutawikweitsitɨanikɨ, nutsutɨ mɨtiyumienikɨ? Mɨkɨ kayuwatɨ mekaniumakaitɨni.
Hikɨ yuhaxɨama waruxeiyaka, yuhiwerietɨ memɨtsetse'ikaikɨ yu'iyaritsie, mɨpaɨ tewi katiniutahɨawe: —'Amamá keneutatsera. Mɨkɨ kanitatsera, hikɨ mamaya 'aixɨa 'anetɨ kanayani.
Hikɨ paritseutsixi mewayekɨneka, mɨkɨ herurexitsie memɨtewiyakai wahamatɨa mekaniuyu'enieni Ketsutsi kememɨte'imienikekai.
Teɨteri kememɨteyukuxeɨri harakuna tetsita
Hikɨ Ketsutsi meta teyu'ɨkitɨwametemama yunaitɨ harakuna paitɨ mekanekɨne, meta yumɨiretɨ teɨteri mekanenukuweiya Karereyatari, Kureyatari,
Kerutsaremetari, 'Irumeyatari, Kurutani 'anutaɨyetari, Tiru 'aurie Tsiruni 'aurie kiekatari. Yuwaɨkawatɨ me'u'enanaka naime kemɨtiyurienekai, hetsɨana mekaniu'axɨani.
Hikɨ kaniwaruta'aitɨani teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete 'ahurawa memehanakɨ kanuwa hetsiena mieme, kapa me'itsaipɨnakɨ, teɨteri memɨyumɨirekaikɨ.
Yumɨireme 'aixɨa meteheu'eriekame kaniwarayeitɨwakaitɨni. 'Ayumieme yunaitɨ kwiniya memexeiyakai metsaipɨnetɨ hetsɨana mekani'axekaitɨni me'imayɨanike, 'ayumieme kanuwa kaniuta'aita.
Kakaɨyarixi memɨka'itiyatɨka me'ixeiyatɨ, hɨxiena mekaniukaxɨrɨwekaitɨni, mɨpaɨ mete'uhiwatɨ: «'Ekɨ Kakaɨyari pekaninu'ayatɨni».
Matsi mɨkɨ kaniwaku'imaiyakaitɨni yemekɨ memɨka'ikuxatanikɨ kapa matsiɨkɨme meheyeitɨanikɨ.
Tamamata heimana yuhutame kemɨtiwaranuyexei nɨ'ariekate
Hikɨ hɨritsie kaneutiyune. Mɨme mɨwaranuyexei kaniwaruta'inieni hetsiena memɨtewiyanikɨ. Me'ayekɨneka teɨteri watsata, hetsiena mekateniuwiya.
Tamamata heimana yuhutame kaniwaranuyeteɨxɨ. 'Arike kaniwatanɨ'axɨanikekaitɨni memɨtekuxatanikɨ meta hamatɨana memu'uwanikɨ,
heitserie kaniwapitɨanikekaitɨni 'aixɨa meteheu'eriekame memɨwarayeitɨwanikɨ tekwikwikate, meta memɨwarayenɨ'axɨanikɨ kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene.
'Ikɨ mepɨhɨkɨ tamamata heimana huta muwaranayexei: Tsimuni (Ketsutsi mɨtiterɨwaxɨ Pekuru),
Kakuwu Tsewereu nu'aya, Wani Kakuwu 'iwaya (Ketsutsi mɨtiwaruterɨwaxɨ Wuhaneriketsi, manuyɨne: Tɨrarɨkamete),
'Atɨrexi, Piripe, Wariturume, Mateu, Tumaxi, Kakuwu 'Aripeu nu'aya, Tareu, Tsimuni mɨkananitsitatɨkai,
meta Kura 'Itsikariutitanaka 'arike Ketsutsi mɨyetua. Kemɨ'ane 'axa'utaitɨ mitsewixima 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata (Mar 3:23-27 – Mat 12:25-29, Ruk 11:14-22) Hikɨ kiita mekaneutahaxɨani.
Tawarita yuwaɨkawatɨ teɨteri me'u'axɨaku mɨkɨ mepɨyutatexi metekwanike.
Hikɨ maremama me'u'enanaka, mekaniu'axɨani memenuhanakɨ. Mɨpaɨ mekateniyɨkɨhɨawekaitɨni: «'Atsipɨkatimate kemɨtiyuriene».

Mɨkɨ meta 'inɨarikɨ memɨte'ɨkitametetɨkai, Kerutsaremetsie memeyekɨnekai, mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni: «Weheritsewu pinɨ'ɨ. Kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene tiwa'aitɨwame 'iparewiekaku kaniwarayenɨ'awani kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene».
Hikɨ Ketsutsi yu'aurie warutakwewieka, 'ɨxatsikɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'ɨkitɨani: «¿Kauyumarie ketiyɨwe mayuyenɨ'anikɨ yɨkɨmana?
Yaxeikɨata, xeime kwieyaritsie kiekatari xɨka hixɨata meyutsana, xɨka me'ayuka'unieka, mɨkɨ wakuwiyexinu pɨkayɨweni 'emɨreutewinikɨ.
Xeime kie miemete hixɨata xɨka meyutsana, xɨka me'ayuka'unieka, mepɨkayɨwaweni 'ememɨteheutewinikɨ.
Yaxeikɨata, kauyumarie xɨka yuka'unarɨmenike, tɨrɨkariyaya hixɨata xɨka yutsanake, 'emɨreutewinikɨ pɨkayɨwenikeyu. Pɨtaxɨximenikeyu pɨta.
Merikɨte, xewitɨ pɨkayɨwe mɨtinawani tewi mɨtɨrɨkaɨye tita yukiita mɨrexeiya, mɨkɨ tewi katiuhɨani meri, 'anake kaniyɨwemɨkɨ piiniteya naime mɨtiunawani.
Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe, naime 'axakememɨteyurie teɨteri, mepɨyɨwawe memɨteheuyehɨwiyarienikɨ naime 'axamemutiyuane.
Matsi kemɨ'ane 'axamɨtayɨni Kakaɨyari 'Iyarieya Mɨtiyupata hepaɨtsita, mɨkɨ hatsuaku pɨkareuyehɨwiyarieni mɨkɨkɨ. Hetsiena matsi katiniuhɨiwani, yuheyemekɨ 'emuwekɨ tita 'axamɨtiuyuri».
'Ipaɨ kaniutayɨni, mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ memutiyuanekaikɨ: «Kakaɨyari mɨka'itiya kaninɨka».
Ketsutsi 'iwamama meta maamaya
Hikɨ maamaya meta 'iwamama yunaitɨ mekaniu'axɨani. Takwa mekaniti'uni mekatenitanɨ'airieni yu'aurie me'ikwewietɨ.
Teɨteri yumɨiretɨ mekanayetekaitɨni hamatɨana, mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —Neuxei, 'amaama meta 'a'iwama mepɨmatsiha'iwawa takwa paitɨ.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —¿Kehateri nemaama meta ne'iwama?
Waranuxeiyatɨyaka 'auriena mematekai, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Kamɨ 'ena nemaama meta ne'iwama.
Kemɨ'ane yamɨtiyuriene kemɨtinake Kakaɨyari, mɨkɨ kanine'iwatɨni kaninemaamatɨni.
